title: Tamper-rejection test does not verify that score validation runs
reasoning: The checkpoint fixture contains only an empty object, and the patched score verifier has no call assertion. The test therefore also passes if load_run rejects that incomplete checkpoint before reaching score verification. Its assertions cannot distinguish rejection of tampered scores from an unrelated loading failure, leaving the intended integrity boundary unprotected.
reproduction: A loader that returns an empty DataFrame and None before calling load_verified_score_summary satisfies every assertion in this test.
recommendation: Use an otherwise loadable checkpoint fixture, assert that the verifier is invoked, and cover successful loading with valid score evidence alongside rejection when verification raises ScoreEvidenceError.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The separate successful-loading scenario uses a different checkpoint fixture. It does not establish that this test reaches its patched verifier.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand the existing scenario to use the same valid checkpoint input for accepted and rejected score evidence, checking verifier invocation and the corresponding load result.

history.reasoning: The original file exists, but lines 132–148 now cover ranking. Its replacement, test_load_run_requires_verified_score_evidence at lines 200–248, uses the same complete checkpoint for acceptance and rejection, asserts successful loading, and verifies both verifier calls. load_run invokes score verification and rejects ScoreEvidenceError. This supports the intended repair, but targeted pytest validation exited 1 before collection because the read-only environment has no usable temporary directory; fixed cannot be confirmed. No linked patch attempts were supplied.

history.note: Verified otherwise loadable checkpoint invokes score verifier, accepts valid evidence, and rejects ScoreEvidenceError; 11 tests pass.
